description: Header file defining the SimpleBuffer class for managing contiguous data buffers with growable capacity, including methods for reading, writing, and pointer management.

classes.name: SimpleBuffer
classes.description: A class that manages a growable, contiguous data buffer with read/write capabilities.

methods.name: SimpleBuffer(int size)
methods.description: Constructor that reserves at least `size` capacity.

methods.name: ReadableBytes()
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: Empty()
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: WriteString(absl::string_view piece)
methods.description: Writes a string view into the buffer.

methods.name: GetReadableRegion()
methods.description: Returns the readable region as a string_view.

methods.name: Read(char* bytes, int size)
methods.description: Reads bytes out of the buffer.

methods.name: Clear()
methods.description: Resets the buffer to empty state.

methods.name: Reserve(int size)
methods.description: Ensures at least `size` bytes can be written.

methods.name: ReleaseAsSlice()
methods.description: Releases buffer contents as a MemSlice.
